home.title: Empowering Citizens. Transforming Cities.
home.subtitle: The AI-powered Decision Intelligence Platform for proactive civic management and rapid issue resolution.
home.flowSubtitle: From a citizen's camera to a resolved community issue in record time.
home.flow1Desc: A resident spots an issue and snaps a quick photo.
home.flow2Desc: AI assesses the scene, detects objects, and verifies evidence.
home.flow3Desc: The issue is scored by severity and routed to the correct department.
home.flow4Desc: Officers review the AI brief and dispatch a maintenance team.
home.flow5Desc: The issue is resolved, and citizens are kept in the loop transparently.
home.impactDesc: A deep pothole reported on a busy intersection today gets resolved tomorrow morning, because CivicMind AI instantly flagged it as a Critical Hazard and routed it directly to the Road Safety division before human dispatchers even arrived at the office.
home.impactCTA: Ask AI Assistant about risk prediction
home.reasoningText: Image evidence confirms severe road displacement (depth ~15cm) on a high-density primary artery. High risk of immediate vehicle damage and public traffic accidents.
home.footerDesc: Transforming city maintenance through computer vision, automated evidence verification, and predictive civic intelligence.

report.title: Submit a Civic Report
report.subtitle: Help improve your community by reporting infrastructure problems with instant AI verification.
report.step1Sub: Describe the issue in your own words. Gemini will automatically extract key details.
report.step2Sub: Provide the nearest landmark, area, or street address.
report.step3Sub: Snap a photo or upload an image. AI vision requires this to verify evidence.
report.descPlaceholder: e.g. There is a huge pothole causing traffic jams, it looks quite dangerous for bikes...
report.locationPlaceholder: e.g. 123 Main Street, Near Central Park, Andheri East
report.clickOrDrag: Click or drag an image here
report.agentStep1: Vision Agent: Detecting objects in scene...
report.unclearSub: The AI could not clearly identify the issue from the provided image. Please upload a clearer photo.
report.verifiedSub: AI vision has processed and structured your submission.
report.guideline1: Capture clear daylight photos showing full context.
report.guideline2: Provide recognizable landmarks for rapid dispatch.
report.guideline3: Voice input is supported in English, Hindi & Marathi.
report.uploadDesc: Take or upload a clear photo of the issue
report.dragDrop: Drag & drop or click to upload
report.photoRequired: A clear photo is required for AI analysis
report.successDesc: Your complaint has been registered and is under AI review.
